opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK higher education institutions, and (on a trial basis) UK-based independent research institutes/organisations.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project. The outline stage is paused; detailed applications are being accepted until 1 September 2026 for invited applicants.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers; some specialist arts institutions permitted.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring novel expertise and enhance skills in an underrepresented area of research.
